tracks.title: HoloCanvas
tracks.summary: Browse, replay, build and share infinite-canvas walkthroughs from one library.
tracks.overview:
**HoloCanvas** is the library for your infinite-canvas walkthroughs: spatial presentations made of cards laid out on a canvas and a sequence of scenes that fly between them. It lives at `/canvas`.

- **Browse.** A gallery of saved canvases with scene and card counts, filtered by tag. Canvases your agents save, such as work reviews, show up here too.
- **Preview and replay.** Select a canvas to play it inline, or **Re-emit** it as an on-screen overlay.
- **Build.** Turn a report into a walkthrough (each section becomes a card and a scene), paste a walkthrough payload as JSON, or load two short neutral examples.
- **Narrate.** **Bake Narration** generates per-scene narration audio.
- **Share and export.** Copy a `/canvas/<id>` share link or download a single-file HTML export.

The canvas runtime is part of InfiniBot core: agents can still show walkthroughs, and share links keep working when this plugin is off. Turning it off hides the library; your saved canvases are kept. The tours load the two example canvases (they're neutral and only added once) and open dialogs, but never delete, bake, re-emit or save anything else.

walkthroughs.title: Tour the library
walkthroughs.summary: The header actions, tag filter, gallery and preview pane.

steps.title: The HoloCanvas library
steps.body: Every saved walkthrough canvas in one place, with a count. The buttons on the right create new ones.

steps.title: Filter by tag
steps.body: Tags come from the canvases themselves. Pick one to narrow the gallery, or **All** to see everything.

steps.title: The gallery
steps.body: Each card shows the title, how many cards and scenes it has, its tags, and **✓ baked** once narration audio exists. Canvases your agents save, such as work reviews, land here too.

steps.title: The preview pane
steps.body: Select a canvas and it plays here, with actions to narrate, share, export and re-show it.

walkthroughs.title: Preview, replay and share
walkthroughs.summary: Load the example canvases, play one, and see how to share or export it.

steps.title: Load the examples
steps.body: Click **Load examples** to add two short example canvases. They're neutral and only ever added once.

practice.note: Adds the two built-in example canvases to your library (idempotent). Nothing else is changed.

steps.title: Open a canvas
steps.body: Click a canvas card to preview it.

steps.title: Play it inline
steps.body: The walkthrough plays here scene by scene. When it ends it starts again from the first scene.

steps.title: Share and export
steps.body: **Copy Link** copies a `/canvas/<id>` share link, which keeps working even with this plugin off. **Download HTML** saves a single-file export you can open anywhere.

steps.title: Narrate and re-show
steps.body: **Bake Narration** generates per-scene audio with your voice provider. **Re-emit** shows the canvas again as an on-screen overlay. **Delete** removes it from the library.

practice.note: The tour doesn't bake (it uses your speech provider), re-emit or delete.

walkthroughs.title: Build a new canvas
walkthroughs.summary: From a report, or from a pasted walkthrough payload.

steps.title: Pick a report
steps.body: Your reports are listed here. Converting one turns each section into a card and a scene, and saves the result to the library.

steps.title: Paste a payload
steps.body: Click **+ New** to save a canvas from its JSON payload.

steps.title: The payload
steps.body: Paste the walkthrough JSON: its `nodes` (the cards) and `scenes`. Agents produce this format when they show a walkthrough. Add comma-separated tags below it.

options: Cards laid out on an infinite canvas plus a sequence of scenes that move between them
A slide deck exported from PowerPoint
quiz.explain: A canvas has nodes (cards) and scenes; playback moves through the scenes.

quiz.prompt: What happens when you build a canvas from a report?
options: Each report section becomes a card and a scene
quiz.explain: The report's sections map onto cards and scenes, and the canvas is saved to the library.

quiz.prompt: You turn the HoloCanvas plugin off. What still works?
options: Share links and agents showing walkthroughs; the library page is hidden and canvases are kept
Only downloaded HTML exports, and share links break
quiz.explain: The canvas runtime is core; the plugin only adds the library.
Baked canvases show a ✓ baked badge and play narration per scene.
